objective: Observe how professionals actually revised glyphs across published stages and make their choices auditable, separate from guessing static texture parameters.
actual_experiments_past: R5 role-based tips no visual design uplift
R8 conservative compensation passes geometry not aesthetics
R9 density-based component width no aesthetic uplift

source_observations.creator: 汉仪字库
source_observations.publisher: DFA Design for Asia Awards official showcase
source_observations.physical_evidence: A published illustration presents identical historical-style Chinese characters in three art-production stages (gray reference, hand-painted first draft, finished black glyph). Separate final glyphs show strongly altered black masses and edge endings.
source_observations.author_stated_process: The award entry attributes a bold calligraphic design, high-contrast stroke strength and decorative wavy terminals to Hanyi's Li-inspired typeface.
source_observations.not_claimed: This is NOT raw calligrapher pen path, editable sketches, nor one-to-one registration of source glyph components. It cannot reveal exact spline equations or training of generative model.
source_observations.operational_hypothesis: First reconstruct a coherent stroke gesture and positive/negative shape at full-glyph level, then detail the edge; a finished contour model should not be reduced to uniformly tapered HanziWriter centerlines.
source_observations.style_scope: expressive calligraphic font; not automatically a transferable 六島 design program

source_observations.creator: Typotheque / Zheng Chuyang
source_observations.physical_evidence: Actual same-character outline comparison marks BEFORE in red and AFTER in cyan/blue; authored edit is visible on the contour. The image's red and blue pixels were both verified.
source_observations.author_stated_process: Lead designer explicitly reports an experimental widening of 口 to appear contemporary; the choice was reversed after thousands of glyphs made the family-wide imbalance clear. Evaluations occur at hundreds/thousands of characters.
source_observations.not_claimed: The revised glyph's small differences may not be the 口-radical reversal itself. Do NOT map the 口 anecdote onto this image's exact outline without direct author statement.
source_observations.operational_hypothesis: A local motif change is a conditional candidate and must survive a multi-glyph density and rhythm review; otherwise retract it even if individual glyph is nicer.
source_observations.counterexample: For a two-character independent commercial wordmark, the review should compare both glyphs in logo size; a 40,000-character font family criterion cannot simply be copied unchanged.
source_observations.style_scope: large CJK font-family quality assurance, not freehand calligraphic poster

source_observations.creator: Arphic 文鼎字型 / Lin Mickey
source_observations.physical_evidence: Creator-operated project page presents Before/After paired Chinese sample phrases and zoomed local terminal/counter adjustments at condensed C80 design; separate detail sheet shows changes to standard character proportions.
source_observations.author_stated_process: The published creator page describes modern cut corners, open center counters, balanced white space and two-dimensional variable font weight/width styles. The source images label their own before/after adjustment.
source_observations.not_claimed: A condensed variant is not necessarily a chronological drafting stage. No claim about the original designer's brush motion or about permission to redistribute the proprietary font.
source_observations.operational_hypothesis: When narrowing a word or stroke, reconstruct counters and hooks optically rather than horizontally scaling every path. Reject if narrow version is illegible or loses character-family consistency.
source_observations.style_scope: condensed screen/display readable type; visual craft differs from energetic ink logo

critical_project_correction: R1-R9 optimized a mathematical transformation of an already chosen normalized skeleton. Actual creator evidence is iterative, goal-conditioned selection and reversal of glyph-level decisions across multiple characters; no source can justify a universal thickness/spacing formula.
next_safest_stage: Freeze ONE visually documented author decision with an original before/after pair, validate effect on multiple held-out glyphs with paired real visual outputs and equal budget; no promotion absent independent aesthetic preference.
